About
Incorporated in 1994, Transwarranty Finance Ltd is an NBFC engaged in lending and advisory services
Key Points
Business Overview:
[1]
TFL has strong business association with large corporates and over 500 SME / MSMEs for 25+ yrs. It deals in trade finance, debt & equity & structured deals. Company has lending focused on niche social impact and Fintech segments with advisory business services for trade finance to investment banking. It operates though ~ 150 offices and ~ 20,000 registered clients. It also deals in third party products like Mutual funds, Bonds & Debentures and Fixed Deposits. TFL is IRDA approved corporate agency for life, general and medical insurance.
